title: Symptom assistant
subtitle: Tell us what's wrong. We'll suggest the right department.
greeting: Hello! I'm the MediFlow assistant. Tell me what's bothering you, in your own words. You can type or tap the microphone.

questions.more: Could you tell me a little more? Which part of the body is affected, and what do you feel?
questions.duration: How long have you had this?
questions.severity: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is it right now?
questions.conditions: Do you have any long-term conditions, like diabetes or high blood pressure? You can say 'none'.

safety.cardiology: One safety question: is the pain spreading to your arm, jaw or back, or are you sweating or short of breath right now?
safety.paediatrics: One safety question: is the child very drowsy, having fits, struggling to breathe, or not drinking anything?
safety.neurology: One safety question: is there sudden weakness on one side, slurred speech, or the worst headache of your life?
safety.obgyn: One safety question: are you pregnant and having heavy bleeding or severe stomach pain right now?
safety.default: One safety question: do you have severe pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or heavy bleeding right now?

repeat.severity: Please give a number from 1 (mild) to 10 (the worst).
repeat.age: Please tell me the age in years, for example 45.
repeat.safety: Please answer yes or no, so I can make sure you're safe.

reply.recommendation: Thank you. Based on what you told me, {{department}} is the right department for you.
reply.emergency: What you described needs urgent attention. Please don't wait for an appointment.
reply.escalated: I'd like a member of our team to help you with this.

chat.voiceUnsupported: Voice input isn't available in this browser. Please type instead.
chat.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Please type instead.
chat.voiceError: We couldn't hear that. Please try again or type.

result.title: Recommended department
result.notDiagnosis: This is a suggestion to help you see the right doctor. It is not a diagnosis. The doctor will examine you.

emergency.title: This needs urgent care
emergency.body: What you described can be a sign of an emergency. Don't wait for an appointment. Call 108 or go to the hospital's Emergency department now.
emergency.stayWithSomeone: If you can, keep someone with you and show them this screen.
emergency.safetyAnswer: You answered yes to the safety question.

escalated.title: Our team will help you
escalated.unclear_routing: I couldn't work out the right department from what you described. Our front desk has your message and will help you choose.
escalated.asked_for_human: Of course. Our front desk has your message and will contact you.
escalated.safety_unclear: To be safe, our front desk will check your symptoms with you.
escalated.nextSteps: If you're at the hospital, please go to the help desk at the main entrance. If you feel worse at any time, call 108.

howItWorks.title: How it works

steps.describe: Tell us what is bothering you, by typing or speaking.
steps.answer: Answer a few short questions about how long and how bad it is.
steps.book: See the right department and book a doctor who suits you.

howItWorks.alsoAsk: You can also ask "How long will I wait?", or change or cancel an appointment.

orchestrator.greetingName: Hello {{name}}! I'm the MediFlow assistant. Tell me what's bothering you, in your own words. I can also check your queue, and book or change appointments.
orchestrator.rephrased: I can't put that safely in words. Please ask your doctor about it.
orchestrator.triagePaused: The symptom assistant is switched off right now. Please choose a department below.
orchestrator.paused: The assistant is switched off right now. Please choose a department below, or call the hospital.
orchestrator.lowConfidence: I'm not fully sure about this one. You can still book, or our front desk can help you choose.
orchestrator.offerBooking: Shall I find a doctor and book a time for you?
orchestrator.offerToken: Tap "Get a token" to see a doctor today.
orchestrator.bookingBlocked: I can't book an appointment after the warning signs you mentioned. Please call 108 or go to the Emergency department now.
orchestrator.bookNeedsSymptoms: Tell me what's bothering you and I'll find the right department and doctor. Or you can browse all doctors.
orchestrator.noDoctors: No {{department}} doctor has a free time in the next few days. Our front desk can help.
orchestrator.pickDoctor: These {{department}} doctors have the earliest free times. Who would you like to see?
orchestrator.pickTime: Here are the free times. Pick one.
orchestrator.noTimes: There are no free times that day.
orchestrator.booked: Done! Your appointment is booked and your token is {{token}}. You can track the live queue from here.
orchestrator.patientBusy: You already have an appointment at that time. Please pick another time or check your appointments.
orchestrator.slotGone: Sorry, that time was just taken.
orchestrator.rescheduled: Done. Your appointment is now on {{date}} at {{time}}. Token {{token}}.
orchestrator.tooLateToChange: It's too close to the appointment time to change it here. Please call the hospital.
orchestrator.nothingToConfirm: There's nothing waiting for a confirmation.
orchestrator.kioskQueue: To see your place in the queue, go back and choose "Scan booking QR" to check in.
orchestrator.nextAppointment: Your next one is on {{date}} at {{time}} with Dr. {{doctor}}.
orchestrator.queueStatus: Token {{token}}: {{count}} ahead of you. You should be seen around {{time}}.
orchestrator.leaveBy: Leave home by {{time}} to be on time.
orchestrator.kioskAppointments: Please use the MediFlow app or the help desk to see or change appointments.
orchestrator.noBooked: I couldn't find a booked appointment to change.
orchestrator.rescheduleWhich: Your appointment {{token}} is on {{date}} at {{time}}. Pick a new time:
orchestrator.medicineRefused: I can't advise on medicines or doses. Please ask your doctor or pharmacist. If you have a care plan from your doctor, its companion answers from your prescription. If you feel very unwell, call 108.
orchestrator.greetingBack: Hello! Tell me what's bothering you, or ask about your queue or appointments.
orchestrator.keptAppointment: OK, your appointment stays as it is.

trail.title: How this answer was made
trail.departments: Paused: offered the list of departments
trail.doseRefused: Medicine question: only a doctor answers this
trail.rephrased: Reply replaced: it had diagnosis wording
trail.resumed: Agent switched back on by the admin
trail.summary: Summary from the conversation and {{records}} documents

records.saved: Checked and saved by the patient

care.askedDoctor: Not in the care plan: sent to the doctor
care.warning: Warning sign: urgent alert to the doctor
care.same: No change reported: shared with the doctor

cards.emergency: Emergency: please follow the instructions on screen.

picker.empty: No departments are open for booking.
picker.title: Choose a department
picker.body: Pick the department for your problem to see its doctors and book.
picker.pageSubtitle: The symptom assistant is not available right now.

care.welcome_one: Dr. {{doctor}} has signed your prescription. This is your care plan with 1 medicine. Ask me anything about it, for example "I missed my night tablet".
care.welcome_other: Dr. {{doctor}} has signed your prescription. This is your care plan with {{count}} medicines. Ask me anything about it, for example "I missed my night tablet".

answers.missedDose: For a missed dose, your doctor said:
answers.foodIntro: Here is what your prescription says about food:
answers.durationIntro: How long to take each medicine:
answers.followUp: Your doctor wants to see you again on {{date}}.

care.askedDoctor: That isn't covered by your prescription or your doctor's advice, so I've sent your question to Dr. {{doctor}}. The reply will appear here.
care.refusedDose: I can't change or add medicine doses, and please don't change anything on your own. I've asked Dr. {{doctor}} for you.
care.sideEffect: Thank you for telling me. I've passed this to Dr. {{doctor}}. If it gets worse or you feel very unwell, call 108.
care.urgent: This needs attention today. I've sent an urgent alert to Dr. {{doctor}}. Please come to the hospital today, and call 108 at once if it gets worse or you feel faint.
care.emergency: What you described needs urgent care now. Call 108 or go to the Emergency department. I've alerted Dr. {{doctor}}.
care.checkInBetter: Good to hear! Keep taking your medicines as prescribed.
care.checkInSame: Thank you. I've shared this with Dr. {{doctor}}. Keep taking your medicines, and call 108 if you feel worse.

reasons.notInPlan: Not covered by the prescription or advice
reasons.doseChange: Asks about changing a dose or another medicine
reasons.sideEffect: Possible side effect or new symptom
reasons.warning: Warning sign in a check-in reply: {{label}}
